1.o: Prosecutors and formerly married couple, Park Jung Hwan and Shin Ha Gyung, come into conflict when her investigation into possible corporate negligence threatens to undermine Hwan's boss appointment to Prosecutor General.

Tandy Bowen and Tyrone Johnson – two teenagers from very different backgrounds, find themselves burdened and awakened to newly acquired superpowers which are mysteriously linked to one another. The only constant in their lives is danger and each other. Tandy can emit light daggers and Tyrone has the ability to control the power of darkness. They quickly learn they are better together than apart.

2.o: Tandy and Tyrone try to grasp what has happened to them with their new-found powers, while Tandy’s past catches up with her and Tyrone becomes consumed with revenge. Meanwhile, Detective Brigid O’Reilly works an interesting case that has ties to Tandy.

3.o: Tandy is on the run as Detective O’Reilly closes in on her, but the detective may not be after her for the reasons Tandy thinks. Tyrone is desperate for answers and turns to Evita and her Auntie Clarisse, a Voodoo priestess, for help.

4.o: Tandy and Tyrone come face-to-face as the two are able to sit down and talk. Having not been able to tell anyone else what they have been experiencing, both take the opportunity to finally confide in the one person who may truly understand what they are going through. Meanwhile, Otis reveals a secret side of himself and Greg seems to be onto something with Melissa’s case against Roxxon.

5.o: Tandy is consumed with getting answers about the Roxxon cover up. To get the answers she is looking for, Tandy tests out her power to gain new insights. Tyrone, on the other hand, is focusing on being a normal kid as the basketball state finals approach. With so much weighing on him lately, can he truly push everything to the side and win the big game for Billy? Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly looks into the city’s drug problems to get some answers of her own.

6.o: Tyrone heads down a dangerous path to get closer to Det. Connors, as Tandy pretends to be a Roxxon intern in an attempt to get answers. Her “internship” hits a little too close to home for Tandy when she gets a glimpse at what her life could have been like. Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly gets closer to Det. Connors and Evita’s Aunt Clarisse worries about Tyrone’s future.

Unfortunately, getting the answers she needs will be difficult as the man has been in a catatonic state for almost a decade, but it might not be so impossible for two people with extraordinary powers. With Tyrone alongside to help, the two test their combined powers for the first time.

When Tandy gets a key piece of information regarding her father, she uses this day to try and finally clear her father’s name. Deciding today is the day he gets a confession out of Det. Connors, Tyrone goes to Det. O’Reilly for help.

9.o: When triumph turns sour, both Tandy and Tyrone regress back to their old ways. But after everything that has happened, and actions that have been set into motion, can they truly go back to the way things once were? Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly tries to deal with the recent fallout.

1.o: Evolutionary anthropologist Brian Hare searches for the origins of hate in both the past and current day, exploring what causes humans to treat each other with cruelty and violence.

2.o: Cognitive scientist Laurie Santos examines tribalism, asking why love for one group can inspire hate for other groups -- in politics, sports and even warfare -- and how tribal thinking shapes perceptions.

3.o: Journalist Jelani Cobb investigates how hate tools like propaganda, dehumanization, the internet, and symbols can incite, amplify and spread hatred.

4.o: An examination of what drives people to embrace hateful ideas. Extremism expert Sasha Havlicek explores the factors that attract people to ideologies that fuel hate and violence -- from white nationalism to Islamic terrorism.

5.o: International criminal lawyer Patricia Viseur Sellers investigates the perpetrators of genocide and crimes against humanity, from leaders to followers, as well as those who resist the power of hate.

6.o: Neuroscientist Emile Bruneau explores how people can use their capacity for critical thinking, their brain plasticity, and strategies like education and cooperation to help combat hate.

4.o: The case makes national news; Nate confronts his past; Bronwyn makes a surprising discovery.

5.o: The police pressure the suspects; a leaked piece of evidence puts a student in the spotlight.

6.o: The "Bayview Four" investigate their main suspect at the Homecoming dance.

7.t: One of Us Is Not Giving Up
7.o: The "Bayview Four" race against the clock to exonerate one of their own before it's too late.

8.o: The truth about Simon's murder is revealed on Halloween night.

1.o: The lives of a prisoner on death row, a journalist looking for a story, a vicar in a sleepy English town and a maths tutor trapped in a cellar intertwine in a deadly way.

2.o: Condemned prisoner Jefferson Grieff has a mission for journalist Beth Davenport, and vicar Harry Watling faces an impossible choice.

3.o: As Harry’s dilemma worsens, the fate of his family hangs in the balance - but he’s determined to do the right thing. Meanwhile, Beth Davenport meets one of Jefferson Grieff’s helpers in the outside world, who delivers a chilling warning. In the cellar, Janice’s desperation grows.

4.o: As events spiral out of control, Jefferson Grieff prepares to face execution - and time is also running out for Janice Fife in the cellar. An increasingly desperate Harry Watling struggles to do the right thing - but can he stay on the side of the angels and still keep his wife and son safe?

1.t: Han Kang-hee Threw Out Her Fan Letters?
1.o: A young girl in the hospital wishes for her favorite actress, Han Kang-hee, to write back her fan letters. Her father tries his best to grant her wish, but it's not easy getting a top star actress to write back. Meanwhile, Han Kang-hee faces the biggest crisis in her career when rumors of her throwing out her fan letters without even reading them show up in the media.

2.t: So… You're Asking Me to Tell a White Lie?
2.o: Kang-hee finds out that the rumors about her, although good, stemmed from the fake reply letters Jung-seok wrote in her name. Even though she hates things that aren't true, Kang-hee decides to protect Jung-seok and Yu-na's pure hearts. Meanwhile, another scandal regarding Kang-hee begins to arise.

3.t: This Is All Because You Got Involved in My Life.
3.o: Jung-seok learns about Kang-hee's traumatic experience with fan letters, and he prepares a small gift for her. However, the happiness doesn't last long. News of Kang-hee's school violence in high school gets disclosed in the media, shattering her image and destroying her career.

4.t: Let’s Stop Seeing Each Other Now.
4.o: Kang Hee realizes Jung Seok's sincerity and sets her mind to overcome the hardships of her past with him. Meanwhile, out of the blue, Jung Seok hears that Yu Na has gone missing. He races back to the hospital with Kang Hee and desperately searches for Yu Na.

1.o: Wyatt Bernstein, a kid with three sisters, builds a puppet named Crash, who comes to life and becomes his brother he always wanted.

2.o: Crash helps Wyatt with his insect phobia but develops a fear of mustaches himself. Amanda develops a fear of meat.

3.o: Crash becomes the coach of Wyatt's basketball team and ends up benching Wyatt.

4.o: Wyatt takes Crash to school with him, but Crash gets in trouble with the principal.

15.o: Rufus "The Slapper" is stealing everyone's stuff as Wyatt tries to reason with him. Crash ends up captured by Rufus who holds him for a ransom of Wyatt's bicycle which doesn't go well. Meanwhile, Amanda thinks that Mel had killed Crash after he had previously broke the television as Mel takes advantage of this when she is informed of this by Cleo.

16.o: While Wyatt is gathering stuff for the school's rummage sale, Crash becomes extremely jealous when Wyatt finds his old "Flex Fletcher" toy. Meanwhile, Cleo creates a money-making venture at the rummage sale and Amanda raises money for new boots to wear at a party.

17.o: While working with Wyatt on a report about the Roman Empire, Crash gets struck by lightning and receives multiple personalities of Crash (like Chef Crash, Caveman Crash, Southern Millionaire Crash, Cat Crash, and the gladiator Maximus Octavius) which cause trouble immediately.

18.o: Crash, Wyatt and Pesto join the school wrestling team.

21.o: In order to get tickets to the big wrestling, Wyatt and Crash get a job as newsdealers at Roland's newsstand and Crash starts to give customers silly advice which actually works. Meanwhile, Cleo holds a meeting with her friends who have been appointed as Cleo's board of directors and later plans to take advantage of Crash by making him the spokesperson for Cleo.

22.o: Crash believes a trucker hat that he purchased at the Muddy Melee monster truck event brings him luck. When Crash's hat goes missing, he thinks that it has been stolen and suspects Mel, Amanda, Cleo, Jasmine, or Mr. Poulos.

23.o: Crash is obsessed with Wyatt's voice command Cassie at the time when he plans to enter the game show "Crazy Family Awesome Time.

24.o: Mr. Poulous loads up his van to go on a camping trip with his friends. Crash, Wyatt and Pesto sneak into the van to tag along.

25.o: Build-A-Bestie announces a product recall of their dolls. Wyatt and Crash must elude an agent sent to destroy Crash.

1.o: Crash goes through the options of a possible nose to add to his face. Meanwhile, Wyatt and Pesto look for a place to hang out when Amanda, Cleo, and Jasmine take over their usual hang-outs in the apartment with Amanda's modeling plans, Cleo's dance parties, and Jasmine's hide and seek activities.

2.o: Wyatt and Crash are excited for Halloween, but new rules threaten to turn the school into a Halloween-free zone.

3.o: The boys parent an egg for science class, but things turn wacky when Crash becomes obsessed with the egg. Meanwhile, Mel tries to help Cleo master a sport so she can pass gym class.

4.o: Wyatt, Crash and Pesto battle Cleo's team in the school's cup-stacking contest, but Crash gets distracted by a toxic trash heap.

5.o: Amanda pulls a prank on Cleo and Pesto, and the two team up to seek revenge. Meanwhile, Crash and Wyatt are mistakenly invited to join a fraternity on campus.

6.o: Crash is confident after beating Wyatt at arm wrestling so he challenges an action star to a match.

7.o: Wyatt's father Karl Bernstein returns from his globetrotting adventures as a wildlife photographer.

8.o: As Hanukkah approaches, the Bernstein family teaches Crash the traditions of the holiday.

9.o: Crash and Wyatt destroy one of Mel's possessions and Jasmine threatens to tell on them.

10.o: Wyatt, Crash and Pesto encounter Bigfoot when they get stranded on an island.

11.o: Crash eats a book on how to be a mechanic and develops an ability to fix vehicles. Wyatt and Crash take advantage of the situation and open a vehicle repair shop.

1.o: Baek Hyun-woo and Hong Hae-in navigate a tense relationship, both at home and at work. But upon deciding his future, Hyun-woo pays a visit to his family.

2.o: After Hae-in reveals her grim news to Hyun-woo, he begins to treat her nicely. Meanwhile, Hae-in's old classmate returns to Korea and joins Queens Group.

3.o: Hyun-woo discovers troubling evidence after saving Hae-in from a boar attack. Meanwhile, the two slowly find their long-lost feelings reigniting.

4.o: As Yoon Eun-sung increasingly interlopes in Hae-in's life, Hyun-woo begins to feel jealous. Hae-in later shows up for Baek Du-gwan in his time of need.

5.o: As Hyun-woo and Hae-in spend time in his hometown, they awkwardly navigate their complex feelings. Hae-in later receives bad news about her diagnosis.

6.o: Hyun-woo unexpectedly shows up in Berlin to secure a treatment for Hae-in. Meanwhile in Korea, Hong Man-dae faces a crisis at his company.

7.o: Feeling betrayed by Hyun-woo, Hae-in pushes him away and becomes cold. Back in Korea, Hyun-woo begins to unravel a scheme against Hae-in's family.

8.o: Despite being in a tense situation with Hae-in, Hyun-woo remains firm about staying in the company as his suspicions towards Eun-sung grow even stronger.

9.o: Hae-in and her family go into hiding in Hyun-woo's hometown to figure out their next move. Eun-sung discovers the truth about Hae-in's health.

10.o: Eun-sung tracks down Hae-in, presenting her with an ultimatum. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo skillfully uses leverage to get Grace Ko on the Hong family's side.

11.o: Hae-in makes a shocking announcement at a press conference. Hyun-woo launches a risky evidence-collecting crusade to save Queens Group.

12.o: Hae-in's symptoms worsen as she suffers from hallucinations, which Eun-sung takes advantage of. Soon after, Hyun-woo finds himself captured and in danger.

13.o: The Hong family initiates a counterattack against Seul-hee and Eun-sung. Hyun-woo and Hae-in get to experience a freshly renewed life as 'newlyweds.'

14.o: After Hae-in shows hesitation about the surgery, her loved ones try to persuade her. Meanwhile, Eun-sung heads to Germany with a sinister plan.

15.o: As Hae-in recovers from surgery, Eun-sung tries to stay right by her side. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo searches for evidence to vindicate himself.

16.o: Eun-sung executes his final plan to make Hae-in his own. As she tries to escape from his grasp with the help of Hyun-woo, will they finally find peace?

1.o: Within the framework of social drama, the events of the series revolve around a grandfather and his relationship with his grandchildren

وصلت امرأة نبيلة غريبة إلى قرية جبلية منعزلة، تدّعي بأن واحداً من خمسة شباب هو بعث لقوة قديمة دمرت العالم فيما مضى – وستدمره من جديد، إن لم تتمكن من تحديد هويته. لكنّ الوقت أمامهم أقلّ مما ظنوا جميعاً.

2.o: "موارين" و"لان" يقودان القرويين الأربعة إلى بر الأمان، ولم يعلما بعد أيهم ولد النبوءة. لكنّ الأصدقاء ليسوا واثقين من منقذيهما، بالأخص بعد رؤية تمادي "موارين" في تنفيذ مهمتها – وتمادي "لان" في تضليلهم.

3.o: تجد "موارين" و"لان" العون في مكان غير متوقع وغير مرغوب به، في حين يحاول القرويون المتفرقون العودة إلى بعضهم البعض أو إيجاد ملاذ آمن على الأقل. لكن عما قريب سيعرفون جميعاً مدى امتداد نفوذ "الأظلم"، ومدى قلة من يمكنهم الوثوق بهم في طريقهم.

4.o: تعاني "موارين" من الشكّ، في حين أن "لان" يعاني من رفيقهم الجديد. يتساءل "راند" عن "مات" والذي بدوره يتساءل عن نفسه. "إيغوين" و"بيرين" يخوضان مساراً مختلفاً. قوة جديدة مبهرة تُطلق في العالم.

5.o: "بيرين" و"إيغوين" يلتقيان بوجه مألوف. يرى "مات" و"راند" وجوهاً غريبة. تحزن "موارين" و"لان" على فاجعتهما.

6.o: تواجه "موارين" عواقب أفعالها. ويواجه "مات" الظلام داخله. تواجه "إيغوين" المرأة الأقوى في العالم.

7.o: "موارين" ورفاقها ينحرفون عن مسارهم بسبب لقاء غير متوقع. هذا الانحراف سيكشف الكثير من الأمور – هدف "موارين" الحقيقي وماضي "لان" والتصدعات التي تشكّلت بين المجموعة وهوية "التنين المبعوث".

8.o: طوال 20 عاماً، حلمت "موارين" بهذه اللحظة واجتهدت لأجلها. لكنها تعجز عن إيقاف "التنين المبعوث" عن الميل إلى "الظلام".

1.o: موراين، لان، ناينيف، إيغوين، بيرين، ومات وجدوا أنفسهم أكثر وحدة من أيّ وقت مضى.

2.o: شبان منطقة النهرين يكوّنون صداقات جديدة، في حين لان يحاول تصليح علاقة قديمة.

3.o: ناينيف تواجه أكبر مخاوفِها. راند يطلب توجيهاً لقواه من مصدر غير متوقع.

4.o: موراين تبحث عن راند فيما ناينيف تبكي خسارتها.

5.o: موراين وراند يلوذان بالفرار لينجوا بحياتِهِما. إيغوين وناينيف يلتقيان بعدوّ جديد.

6.o: راند يعقد حلفاً خطيراً وإيغوين تستجمع قوتها لتواجه ظروفها العصيبة.

7.o: وجه مألوف يفسد خطط موراين وراند.

8.o: القدر يقود راند ورفاقه إلى عراك لا مفرّ منه مع أشرسِ أعدائهم.

1.o: الفوضى تعم البرج الأبيض بينما يصبح أبطالنا أهدافاً لشر جديد.

2.o: زائر خطير يصل إلى البرج الأبيض. بينما يعود بيرين إلى دياره. يشق راند وإيغوين طريقهما الخاص تحت عين موراين الساهرة.

3.o: تتلقى ناينيف وإيلاين مهمة مميتة. بينما يكتشف بيرين عواقب غضبه وتبدأ لانفير بلعب لعبة خطيرة.

4.o: يواجه راند التاريخ المنسي لعائلته، بينما تكتشف موراين الحقيقة المدمرة عن مستقبلها.

5.o: تكتشف إيغوين السر المظلم لـراند. بينما يقود بيرين عملية إنقاذ جريئة. أما ناينيف وإيلاين ومات ومين فيطاردون السوداوات.

6.o: تتصاعد التوترات بين إيغوين وراند. بينما تتصالح موراين ولان مع مصيرهما.

7.o: يقود بيرين أهل النهرين في معركة ضد عدو قديم.

8.t: He Who Comes with the Dawn
8.o: يواجه ناينيف وإيلاين ومات ومين السوداوات لتحديد مصيرهم. بينما تستعد موراين ولان لمواجهة قدرهما ويبدأ راند وإيغوين في تشكيل مستقبلهما.
